name: Kiln Waster: Fragment of a Tea Bowl with Hare's-Fur Markings and with Large Adhesions of Saggars on the Interior and Exterior Walls
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；12th cent. - 13th cent.；Jian ware: dark gray stoneware with dark brown glaze, the markings in iron oxide; the saggar fragments made of coarse reddish buff firing clay. Recovered from the kilns at Shuiji, Jianyang county, Fujian province
